message.content:
Perform a Core Web Vitals and page load performance audit for https://wati.io.

Context:
- B2B SaaS site on WordPress
- Uses GTM (Google Tag Manager)
- Has inline CSS with animation keyframes
- Uses lazy-loading for images
- Multi-language support (possibly client-side)

Please analyze:
1. Run performance analysis on https://wati.io
2. Identify LCP, INP, CLS issues from the page structure
3. Check resource loading (render-blocking JS/CSS, third-party scripts)
4. Check image optimization (formats, sizes, lazy loading)
5. Check caching headers and CDN usage
6. Check font loading strategy
7. Check JavaScript bundle size impact
8. Identify quick wins for performance improvement

Return a detailed performance report with specific metrics, issues found with severity, and actionable recommendations prioritized by impact.

content.text: I'll perform a comprehensive Core Web Vitals audit for https://wati.io. Let me start by fetching the page and running multiple analyses in parallel.

--- CURL STATS ---
HTTP Code: %{http_code}
Time Total: %{time_total}s
Time TTFB: %{time_starttransfer}s
Time Connect: %{time_connect}s
Time DNS: %{time_namelookup}s
Time SSL: %{time_appconnect}s
Size Download: %{size_download} bytes
Speed Download: %{speed_download} bytes/sec
Num Redirects: %{num_redirects}
"
